title: At 16, he left Ukraine with his mother and suitcases stuffed with 20 notebooks, to save on school supplies.
caption:
At 16, he left Ukraine with his mother and suitcases stuffed with 20 notebooks, to save on school supplies.

He stood in line for food stamps. His dad stayed behind and died in 1997. His mom died of cancer in 2000.
Facebook rejected him. His friend Brian told him not to quit.
In 2014, Facebook agreed to pay $19 billion. He signed on the door of his old welfare office.

That kid is Jan Koum, WhatsApp co-founder. Forbes says he is worth $18.6 billion.

Who was your Brian?
